searchTerms.title: Business types
searchTerms.description: What to look for, e.g. "clothing shops", "dentists", "marketing agencies". You can also write "clothing shops in Los Angeles" and leave Locations empty.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Cities, districts or regions, e.g. "Los Angeles" or "Camden, London". Every business type is searched in every location.

maxResultsPerSearch.title: Max results per search
maxResultsPerSearch.description: Upper limit of businesses returned for each business type and location pair. The most complete listings come first.

enrichWebsites.title: Collect contacts from websites
enrichWebsites.description: Visits each business website to collect emails, phone numbers and social media links.

maxPagesPerWebsite.title: Pages per website
maxPagesPerWebsite.description: Home page plus contact / about pages checked on each website.

onlyWithWebsite.title: Only businesses with a website
onlyWithWebsite.description: Skips businesses that have no website listed.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy for website visits
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Used only when visiting business websites. If the proxy cannot be set up the run continues without it.
